request.style: English, contemporary gospel mass choir, call and response between a gritty male lead and the choir, Hammond organ, funky bass and drums, horns, jubilant Easter Sunday, 116 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Early in the morning, the women went
Carrying spices to the grave
They found the stone rolled away
But they did not find his body there

[Verse]
Two men in dazzling clothes stood by them
Why do you seek the living among the dead
He is not here, but he is risen
Remember how he told you what he said

[Chorus]
He got up, he got up
Early Sunday morning, he got up
Death could not hold him, the grave could not keep him
He got up, he got up

[Bridge]
Remember what he said, remember what he said
On the third day he will rise

[Chorus]
He got up, he got up
Early Sunday morning, he got up
Death could not hold him, the grave could not keep him
He got up, he got up
